verdict.rationale: AgentMail provides developer primitives (Labels, Lists, full-text search, webhooks) that a developer could use to build inbox triage, but there is no evidence of AgentMail itself performing AI-driven auto-labeling, categorization, or surfacing-what-needs-attention out of the box — Labels are described as manually tracked conversation states, not an automated triage engine, and no docs describe a built-in AI classifier or steerable/auditable triage policy.
